Eh, this plot of mine is big — over 13 hectares here in Dar es Salaam side, and I intercrop because that way if one crop fails the other one holds. The soil here near the coast is sandy and tired, so I must put some manure from the animals, and maybe a little urea if I can get it at a fair price. I have some money from selling before, so I will buy improved seed for part of the plot, but not all — seed is expensive. For such a big piece, my family alone cannot manage, so I must hire people especially for weeding and harvest; we don't have irrigation, we depend on the rains.
